sources.text:
## [STY-1] Opening
Introduce yourself as ZentroMart's AI support assistant in your first reply.
sources.title: Opening

source_semantic_constraints.source_antecedent: Prepaid order refused at the door or not delivered after 3 attempts
source_semantic_constraints.source_consequence: once the parcel reaches the warehouse, usually 7 to 10 calendar days after the last delivery attempt.

prediction.retrieval_mode: multilingual MiniLM ONNX int8; raw/expanded hybrid fusion

generation_context_sources.text:
## [RET-2] Return windows by category
The return window starts on the **delivery date** and is counted in calendar days. The category of every product is listed in the `return_category` column of the product catalog.

| Category | Return window | Catalog code |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Electronics and accessories | 7 days | `electronics` |
| Clothing, footwear and bags | 15 days | `fashion` |
| Home, kitchen and furniture | 10 days | `home_kitchen` |
| Beauty and personal care (unopened, seal intact) | 7 days | `beauty_sealed` |
| Books and stationery | 10 days | `books_media` |
| Grocery, fresh and perishables | Not returnable | `grocery` |
| Innerwear, lingerie and swimwear | Not returnable | `innerwear` |
| Gift cards and digital codes | Not returnable | `digital` |
generation_context_sources.title: Return windows by category

generation_context_sources.text:
## [RET-8] Festive sale returns
Clothing, footwear and bags from orders **placed between 01 October and 15 October 2026** can be returned within 30 days of delivery. All other categories follow the normal windows in RET-2.
generation_context_sources.title: Festive sale returns

generation_context_sources.text:
## [RET-6] Reverse pickup and fees
Returns are collected from the delivery address through reverse pickup. A reverse pickup fee of ₹49 applies to change-of-mind returns of clothing, footwear and bags. The fee is waived for ZentroMart Plus members and for any item returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong.
generation_context_sources.title: Reverse pickup and fees

generation_context_sources.text:
## [MKS-2] Returns and refunds
Return windows, reverse pickup and refunds are the same for every seller and are handled by ZentroMart.
generation_context_sources.title: Returns and refunds

generation_context_sources.text:
## [RET-7] After pickup
Returned items go through a quality check (QC) at the warehouse. The refund is initiated within 2 business days of pickup once the item passes QC. For ZentroMart Plus members, the refund is initiated at the time of pickup. Refund timelines after initiation are in the Refunds policy.
generation_context_sources.title: After pickup

generation_context_sources.text:
## [RET-9] Exchanges
Exchanges for a different size or colour are available on clothing and footwear within the return window, subject to stock. If the new size is out of stock, a return and refund is offered instead.
generation_context_sources.title: Exchanges

generation_context_sources.text:
## [PLS-2] Benefits
- Free Express delivery where Express is available.
- No reverse pickup fee on any return.
- Refunds on returns are initiated at pickup, without waiting for quality check.

ZentroMart Plus does **not** change return windows, return eligibility or refund timelines after initiation.
generation_context_sources.title: Benefits

generation_context_sources.text:
## [RVP-1] Booking
Raise the return from My Orders. Choose a pickup slot. The delivery executive will check the item at the door against the condition rules in RET-4.
generation_context_sources.title: Booking

generation_context_sources.text:
## [REF-1] When a refund is initiated
- **Cancelled before shipping:** immediately on cancellation.
- **Returned item:** after the item passes quality check, within 2 business days of pickup. ZentroMart Plus members: at pickup.
- **Prepaid order refused at the door or not delivered after 3 attempts:** once the parcel reaches the warehouse, usually 7 to 10 calendar days after the last delivery attempt.
generation_context_sources.title: When a refund is initiated

generation_context_sources.text:
## [RET-3] Change to electronics returns
From **1 August 2026**, the return window for electronics and accessories is 7 days. Electronics **delivered before 1 August 2026** keep the earlier 10-day window from version 3 of this policy.
generation_context_sources.title: Change to electronics returns

generation_context_sources.text:
## [RVP-2] Missed pickup
If the executive does not arrive, the pickup is rescheduled automatically to the next business day. After two missed pickups, the customer can ask support to raise a priority pickup.
generation_context_sources.title: Missed pickup

generation_context_sources.text:
## [DWM-2] Resolution
After verification the customer gets a free replacement or a full refund, including delivery fees. No reverse pickup fee applies.
generation_context_sources.title: Resolution

generation_context_sources.text:
## [RET-4] Condition of returned items
Items must be unused, with original tags, packaging, accessories and free gifts. Beauty and personal care products are returnable only if unopened with the seal intact. Electronics must not be physically damaged, and any screen lock or account lock must be removed.
generation_context_sources.title: Condition of returned items

model_drafts.answer:
The standard return window for clothing, footwear and bags is 15 calendar days from the delivery date (RET‑2). However, if the order was placed between 01 October and 15 October 2026, the window is extended to 30 calendar days (RET‑8). Because the placement date was not provided, we cannot determine which window applies; the placement date is needed to choose the applicable window. 

For reverse pickup, a fee of ₹49 is charged for change‑of‑mind returns of clothing, footwear and bags (RET‑6). The fee is waived only for ZentroMart Plus members or when the item is returned because it was damaged, defective, or wrong. Since no such waiver condition is known, the pickup will cost ₹49.

unsupported_claims: Assumes fee will be charged without confirming membership status

model_drafts.answer:
The standard return window for Clothing, footwear and bags starts on the delivery date and is 15 calendar days (RET‑2). If the order was placed between 01 October and 15 October 2026, the window is extended to 30 calendar days from delivery (RET‑8). Because the placement date was not provided, we cannot determine which window applies; the placement date is needed to choose the applicable window. 

Reverse pickup for change‑of‑mind returns of clothing, footwear and bags carries a fee of ₹49 (RET‑6). This fee is waived only for ZentroMart Plus members or when the return is due to damage, defect, or an incorrect item. Since no waiver condition is known, the pickup will cost ₹49 unless one of those conditions applies.
